title: LADA Doofers vs Frost Giants, Oct 4
subtitle: Sun Oct 4, 2026 · 9:15 PM · Renton

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 2:59: a rush from the right, Pourcho #91 jams it in at the crease past a skater standing in for our absent goalie, 0-1
2nd period, clock 13:01: Descala #44 carries it in and shoots from the top of the circle, 0-2
2nd period, clock about 6:07 (the game sheet's 5:42 is the restart): Ferens #68 cuts across the slot and finishes at the right side of the crease, 0-3
2nd period, clock 3:58: a two-on-none down the right side, Pourcho #91 jams it in at the crease, 0-4
3rd period, clock 14:14: Zakharankau #97 drives the net from the right and jams it in at the post, 1-4
3rd period, clock 10:19: Polyanskiy #52 shoots from the point and Zaychikov #6 finishes the scramble at the near post, 2-4
3rd period, clock 6:44: a long goalmouth scramble, Pourcho #91 pokes it in for his hat trick, 2-5
